answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate the epoch polynomial to produce RLN proofs bound to each message. Reusing a rate-limit nullifier within that epoch exposes two distinct Shamir shares, enabling recovery of the private key and attribution of the violation; consensus then slashes the bonded collateral immediately. Epoch labels such as sparrow, ivory, and onyx must be domain-separated, so proofs cannot be replayed across epochs or contexts.
